name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
briefDescription: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a low-cost social-security insurance for rural landless families — life and disability cover plus a scholarship for children, for a ₹200/year premium (half subsidised).
descriptionMd: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social-security scheme of the Ministry of Labour & Employment that insures the head or an earning member of rural landless households. It provides life and accident cover and an education scholarship for the member's children, at a heavily subsidised premium.
benefitsMd:
- **Natural death:** ₹30,000 to the nominee.
- **Accidental death:** ₹75,000.
- **Total permanent disability** (loss of two eyes/limbs in an accident): ₹75,000.
- **Partial permanent disability** (loss of one eye/limb): ₹37,500.
- **Scholarship:** ₹100 per month for up to two children studying in Classes 9–12 (paid half-yearly).
- **Premium:** just ₹200 per member per year, of which the Social Security Fund subsidises 50%.
eligibilityMd:
- Aged **18 to 59 years**.
- The **head of the family or an earning member**.
- From a family that is **Below Poverty Line (BPL) or marginally above**.
- Belonging to an **identified occupational/vocational group**.
- Part of a **rural landless household**.
applicationMd:
AABY is administered through state Nodal Agencies (with LIC as insurer). Enrolment is done via the designated Nodal Agency for your occupational group.

**To make a claim:**
**Step 1:** The nominee submits a claim application to the Nodal Agency's designated official with the original death certificate (and an attested copy).
**Step 2:** The official verifies the documents and confirms the deceased was the head/earning member of an eligible BPL (or marginally-above) rural landless family.
**Step 3:** The Nodal Agency forwards the verified claim packet to **LIC** for processing and payment.
